bank.prompt_template:
Solve the problem. Show concise reasoning and end with the numeric answer.

A box starts with {start} items, receives {added}, then gives away {removed}. How many remain?
bank.generation_order: prompt index ascending; four repeated rows per prompt; one group generated at a time
bank.prompt_encoding: raw tokenizer text encoding with tokenizer defaults; left padded within group
bank.reward: forkcert numeric reward using the last parsed number
bank.advantage: float32 (reward-group_mean)/(sample_std_Bessel+1e-4) within each group of four
bank.all_tied_rule: retain tied groups with zero advantages; all groups tied makes this state endpoint UNINSTANTIATED, with no resampling for signal
bank.old_logprob: common eager pre-state scorer, FP16 autocast, SDPA MATH, temperature 1.0
bank.artifact_rule: prompt/completion/mask/old-logp/advantage/RNG identities recorded; two fresh bank generations must hash exactly for this smoke

endpoint.aggregation: within-completion valid-token mean, then equal mean over all 32 completions
endpoint.post_state_evaluator: same common eager FP16 SDPA-math scorer for both post states

nonclaims: selected-state T1a does not estimate population B
the sampled bank is baseline-anchored and does not represent all possible rollouts
GRPO surrogate shift is not identical to reward shift or long-run training harm
common eager scoring is a shared ruler, not truth
this smoke is not operator attribution or correctness evidence
